items.title: What Should World Models Plan Over? Learning Geometry-Aligned Representations of Body Motion
items.body: We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.
items.title_ko: 월드 모델은 무엇을 계획해야 하는가? 신체 움직임의 기하학적 정렬 표현 학습
items.summary_ko: MotionPort는 정확한 동적 예측과 효과적인 장기 계획을 위해 신체 움직임의 저차원 잠재 표현을 학습합니다. 이 연구는 기존 월드 모델 플래너의 예측 정확도와 최적화 간의 불일치를 해결하기 위해 액션 청크 대신 신체 궤적을 표현하고 검색 공간을 조직합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 공학 및 시뮬레이션 분야에서 월드 모델의 계획 능력을 향상시키기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하며, 복잡한 신체 움직임을 더 효율적으로 제어하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Why Units Die in the Layer After a Frozen Random Encoder, and What the Number of Live Units Measures
items.body: Reinforcement-learning agents can learn Atari games through a convolutional encoder whose random weights are never trained. They reach expert play in Pong and, without random action repeats, in Breakout, but training takes far longer and few ReLU units in the layer after the encoder stay alive. A dead unit outputs zero for every input and cannot learn. In earlier work we took the number of live units to measure the game's complexity. Here we ask why units die and correct that conclusion. We find that more units die as the layer's inputs lie farther from zero relative to how much they vary. We call this ratio the offset. Earlier work showed this in sparse autoencoders at the start of training. We saw it after training in agents, image classifiers, a reservoir computer and sparse autoencoders on GPT-2. A random encoder leaves the offset of its input roughly unchanged, and a formula predicted its median offset within 25 percent in all 44 cases. So a game with a bright, mostly unchanging screen gives the next layer a large offset. In Pong, subtracting the average screen raised the number of live units from between 3 and 6 of 64 to between 59 and 63, so the number alone cannot show a game's complexity. On unaltered screens none of the agents reached a training score of 18 in 50 million steps. With the subtraction all did within 5 million, about as fast as a trained encoder on unaltered screens. In Breakout the subtraction left more units alive, but average training scores did not clearly improve, and a large gap to a trained encoder remained. So we do not treat their number as something to raise for its own sake. The evidence is from small networks and three games, and in agents and image classifiers changing the offset also changed the size of the inputs. We suggest measuring the offset before training a layer on a fixed front end and, if it is large, trying to subtract the mean input.
items.title_ko: 고정된 랜덤 인코더 후 레이어에서 유닛이 죽는 이유와 활성 유닛 수의 의미
items.summary_ko: 랜덤 가중치를 가진 고정된 컨볼루션 인코더를 통해 아타리 게임을 학습하는 강화 학습 에이전트 연구에서, 인코더 다음 레이어의 ReLU 유닛 중 상당수가 비활성화(dead)되는 현상을 분석했습니다. 이 연구는 유닛이 죽는 이유를 밝히고, 활성 유닛 수가 게임의 복잡성을 측정한다는 이전 결론을 수정합니다.
items.why_ko: 딥러닝 모델, 특히 강화 학습 모델의 학습 과정에서 발생하는 '죽은 유닛' 현상에 대한 이해를 깊게 하여, 모델 효율성과 학습 메커니즘 개선에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Refine, Don't Reinvent: RASA-Bench for Source-Grounded Hindi Prose Refinement
items.body: For a producer of Hindi creative prose, drafting is cheap and editing is not: a machine-written episode, story, or essay reads as under-written and flat, laced with translationese, and it sometimes quietly alters what the source says. RASA-Bench targets that editing task across three Hindi prose forms, measuring how well a model refines an under-written AI draft, a task distinct from writing from scratch. Across 2,050 drafts and eight refiners (16,400 rewrites), a four-layer protocol credits a rewrite only after it passes a faithfulness check against its own source, then ranks the survivors by holistic editorial preference through per-form Bradley-Terry fits whose centered coefficients are standardized before equal-weight averaging. Staying faithful proves to be a decisive test that behaves differently by form: gate-failure rates range from 9.1% on short stories to 29.5% on audio fiction, and the drift that disqualifies a rewrite shifts from events and identity in narrative to claims and evidence in essays. A 600-case human audit puts gate agreement at 0.925 (0.91 to 0.94 across forms), whereas subjective preference is form-sensitive and least settled for essays, among human readers no less than the model judge. The benchmark, evaluation protocol, and Hindi prose diagnostics are available at https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench.
items.title_ko: 새로운 발명 대신 개선: 힌디어 산문 개선을 위한 RASA-Bench
items.summary_ko: RASA-Bench는 힌디어 창작 산문의 기계 생성 초고를 사람이 작성한 것과 같이 자연스럽게 다듬는(refinement) 작업을 평가하는 벤치마크입니다. 이 연구는 AI 모델이 텍스트를 처음부터 작성하는 것과 달리, 기존 초고를 편집하고 개선하는 능력을 측정하는 데 초점을 맞춥니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 창작 능력뿐만 아니라 인간 편집자의 역할을 보조하고, 기계 번역체나 어색한 표현을 자연스러운 문장으로 개선하는 실용적인 텍스트 수정 능력을 평가하는 중요한 방법론을 제시합니다.

items.title: Who Sent It or How It Moved? Sender Shortcuts in Cryptocurrency Anti-Money-Laundering Benchmarks, Audited on Elliptic2 and Elliptic++
items.body: Two public benchmarks dominate graph-based anti-money-laundering (AML) research on Bitcoin: the transaction-level Elliptic dataset, extended as Elliptic++, and the subgraph-level Elliptic2. In both, a label is assigned according to the entity that sends the funds. We ask whether models trained on these benchmarks learn how laundering moves or merely who sent the money, and we propose a diagnostic protocol to tell the two apart: a sender lookup baseline, a novelty baseline, a sender-disjoint split with a leakage check, and a decomposition of performance into sender, receiver and intrinsic signal. On Elliptic2 the task largely reduces to classifying the sender. Under the standard random split, a no-learning lookup of sender history reaches a PR-AUC of 0.954, against 0.975 for gradient boosting on 456 features; our reimplementation of RevClassify reproduces its reported 0.97 and falls to 0.126 without sender information. When senders are held out, performance drops to 0.746, and the subgraph's own structure, transactions and receivers fall from 0.619 to 0.186. On Elliptic++ the same protocol finds the shortcut negligible: sender history reaches only 0.340 against 0.986 for the full model (3.5 against 10.1 times the test prevalence), adding it to the full model raises PR-AUC by less than 0.004 in every seed, and the transaction's own features keep 0.883 when sending addresses are held out. We trace the difference to the unit of sender identity: Elliptic2 senders are entity clusters that recur across many labeled subgraphs, whereas Elliptic++ senders are individual addresses, and fewer than half of test transactions have a sending address seen in training. A shared sender-based label rule thus produces a severe shortcut in one benchmark and a negligible one in the other, so the diagnostic must be run on each benchmark.
items.title_ko: 암호화폐 자금세탁 방지 벤치마크의 송금자 편향 감사: Elliptic2 및 Elliptic++ 사례
items.summary_ko: 암호화폐 자금세탁 방지(AML) 연구에서 널리 사용되는 Elliptic2 및 Elliptic++ 벤치마크가 송금자 정보에 대한 '지름길(sender shortcuts)' 편향을 가질 수 있음을 지적합니다. 모델이 자금세탁의 실제 흐름보다는 누가 돈을 보냈는지에만 의존하여 학습하는 경향을 진단하는 프로토콜을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 AML 시스템의 잠재적 취약점을 밝히고, 보다 견고하고 공정한 모델을 개발하기 위한 데이터셋 및 평가 방법론 개선의 필요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: Deterministic Proper Positive-Only Learning Is Independent of ZFC
items.body: Binary classification from positive-only samples is a variant of PAC learning in which the learner receives i.i.d. samples only from the positive region of an unknown target concept, but is evaluated on the full distribution. Improper learnability in this model has a textbook characterization, whereas proper learnability has remained open for decades. Recent work characterized it for learners with access to randomness, and showed that, unlike in PAC learning, some classes are properly learnable with randomness but not without it, leaving the deterministic case open. We show that this case cannot be resolved within the standard axioms of mathematics (ZFC): there is a class of VC dimension two whose deterministic proper learnability is independent of ZFC, even though a randomized learner provably learns it. Moreover, no dimension of finite character, a desirable property shared by most dimensions in learning theory, characterizes deterministic proper learnability. We also show that the size of the domain is decisive. In ZFC, deterministic proper learnability has a combinatorial characterization on every domain whose cardinality is below a certain threshold, including every countable domain. In contrast, this characterization fails on every domain of sufficiently large cardinality. Under the generalized continuum hypothesis, this threshold is sharp: it is the exact cardinality at which the characterization starts to fail. Finally, our proofs introduce new tools, based on the Erdos--Rado partition theorem, that may be of broader interest.
items.title_ko: 결정론적 정방향 양성 전용 학습은 ZFC와 독립적
items.summary_ko: 양성 전용 샘플(positive-only samples)로부터의 이진 분류 학습(PAC 학습의 변형)에서, 결정론적 정방향 학습(deterministic proper learning)의 특성이 ZFC(집합론 공리계)로부터 독립적이라는 연구 결과입니다. 이는 무작위성을 사용하는 학습기와 달리 수십 년간 미해결로 남아 있던 문제입니다.
items.why_ko: 이론 컴퓨터 과학 및 학습 이론의 근본적인 질문에 대한 해답을 제공하며, 학습 알고리즘의 한계와 가능성을 이해하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering for Trojan-Resilient AI Inference Engines
items.body: Backdoor attacks pose a significant security threat to deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on AI inference engines and hardware accelerators. By embedding hidden triggers during training, these attacks induce malicious behavior while maintaining high accuracy on benign inputs. Multi-trigger backdoor attacks are particularly challenging to detect and mitigate because of the distributed and stealthy nature of their effects. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a training-free Spectral Subspace Filtering framework that detects and suppresses backdoor-induced activations by analyzing latent feature representations. Exploiting the geometric separation between benign and malicious feature distributions, the framework employs Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify the dominant malicious subspace and performs inference-time spectral scrubbing through activation projection. This approach suppresses backdoor effects without model retraining, requiring only a small set of triggered samples collected offline. Experimental evaluation across CNN and transformer architectures, including AlexNet, ResNet18, VGG16, MobileNetV2, and Vision Transformer (ViT), demonstrates that the proposed method reduces the attack success rate (ASR) from 94.2-99.8% to an average of 2.07%, while preserving clean accuracy of up to 98.54% with low inference overhead. The framework also demonstrates robustness across varying poisoning rates and multiple concurrent triggers, highlighting its potential as a lightweight runtime defense for enhancing the security and reliability of AI inference engines against backdoor attacks.
items.title_ko: 경량 스펙트럼 부분 공간 필터링을 통한 트로이 목마 공격 방어 AI 추론 엔진
items.summary_ko: AI 추론 엔진에 배포된 DNN에 대한 백도어 공격, 특히 다중 트리거 백도어 공격을 효과적으로 탐지하고 완화하기 위해 '경량 스펙트럼 부분 공간 필터링(Lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering)' 기법을 제안합니다. 이 기법은 훈련 없이(training-free) 동작합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 보안 취약점인 백도어 공격에 대한 방어 기술을 제시하여, AI 시스템의 신뢰성과 안전성을 높이는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations
items.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-generated advice policy for a long-horizon, sparse-reward task. Degraded advice still meaningfully accelerates learning relative to unaided baselines. These results suggest that LLM-generated advice, though suboptimal, can be a cheap alternative to costly human demonstrations.
items.body_ko: 강화 학습(RL)은 많은 분야에서 상당한 발전을 이루었지만, 에이전트를 \textit{tabula rasa}로 훈련시키는 것은 여전히 샘플 비효율성이 매우 높습니다. 일반적인 해결책은 데모를 통해 사전 학습된 신경망을 사용하여 에이전트를 초기화하는 것입니다. 그러나 데모를 수집하는 것은 비용이 많이 들고, 데모 자체가 최적이 아닐 수 있습니다. 본 연구에서는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 사용하여 사실상 인간의 비용 없이 데모 데이터를 생성하는 조언 정책을 생성합니다. 우리는 이 데이터를 사용하여 DQN 에이전트를 웜스타트하고, 훈련 중에 탐색을 안내하기 위해 조언 정책 자체를 사용합니다. LLM이 생성한 조언은 종종 최적이 아니기 때문에, 우리는 조언 정책의 행동에서 유망한 상태를 인식하도록 에이전트를 초기화하는 가치 웜스타트(value warmstart) 방법을 추가로 도입합니다. 이는 조언 정책의 행동을 직접 복사하지 않습니다. 이 방법의 견고성을 특성화하기 위해, 우리는 장기 희소 보상 작업에 대한 LLM 생성 조언 정책의 개별 하위 기술을 체계적으로 교란합니다. 손상된 조언도 도움 없이 수행하는 기준선에 비해 학습을 의미 있게 가속화합니다. 이러한 결과는 LLM이 생성한 조언이 최적은 아니지만, 비용이 많이 드는 인간 데모의 저렴한 대안이 될 수 있음을 시사합니다.
items.title_ko: LLM 생성 (차선책) 시연을 통한 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 강화 학습(RL)은 샘플 효율성이 낮다는 문제가 있습니다. 이 연구는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 사용하여 시연(demonstration) 데이터를 생성하는 '조언 정책(advice policy)'을 만들어 에이전트 훈련을 초기화함으로써, 인간의 개입 없이도 효율적인 학습을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 강화 학습의 샘플 효율성 문제를 해결하는 데 활용될 수 있음을 보여주어, 실제 환경에서 RL 에이전트를 더 빠르게 훈련하고 배포하는 가능성을 열어줍니다.

items.title: Topological analysis of permeability tensor in anisotropic porous media
items.body: The permeability of an anisotropic porous medium is a tensor whose off-diagonal components, which describe the deflection of the macroscopic flux away from the driving force, are small and change sign under reflections. We ask whether direction-aware topological data analysis can predict the full permeability tensor of three-dimensional porous media directly from their geometry. We introduce two direction-aware topological descriptors for flow problems: a cone-based filtration, adapted from our earlier work on the elastic stiffness tensor, and a throat-scale filtration built on the distance transform of the pore space. Using permeability tensors computed with the lattice Boltzmann method, we compare them with a comprehensive set of non-topological baselines, comprising statistical microstructure descriptors and physics-based permeability estimators. The topological descriptors are most informative for the off-diagonal components, which the baselines capture least well. There the throat-scale filtration alone outperforms every non-topological descriptor set, including the union of all statistical descriptors and physics-based estimators, and adding it to the baselines consistently improves the prediction. We also confirm the approach on real rock data.
items.title_ko: 이방성 다공성 매질에서 투과성 텐서의 위상 분석
items.summary_ko: 이방성 다공성 매질의 투과성 텐서(permeability tensor)를 기하학적 정보로부터 예측하기 위해 방향 인식 위상 데이터 분석(directional-aware topological data analysis)을 연구합니다. 유동 문제에 특화된 두 가지 방향 인식 위상 기술자를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학 및 지구 과학 분야에서 다공성 매질의 특성을 예측하고 이해하는 데 도움을 주어, 새로운 물질 설계나 지하 자원 탐사에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Rethinking Discovery Research with AI: The promise of transdisciplinarity and the danger of reductionism
items.body: In theory, transdisciplinary research focuses on solving real-world problems without being constrained by disciplinary boundaries and methodologies. In practice, doing so is challenging, as recognized by the phrase "The world has problems; universities have departments." As a powerful integrative tool, AI may help overcome traditional reductionist approaches and enable genuine transdisciplinarity. In this essay, we discuss how this could happen and why, within the current system of incentives, it is not happening.
items.title_ko: AI를 통한 발견 연구 재고: 초학제성의 약속과 환원주의의 위험
items.summary_ko: 이 에세이는 AI가 학문 간 경계를 허물고 실제 세계 문제를 해결하는 '초학제성(transdisciplinarity)' 연구를 어떻게 촉진할 수 있는지 논의합니다. 하지만 현재 인센티브 시스템 하에서 AI가 환원주의적 접근을 강화할 위험도 경고합니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 과학 연구 방식에 미치는 잠재적 영향과 함께, 연구 생태계의 변화와 윤리적 고려 사항에 대한 중요한 비판적 관점을 제시합니다.

items.title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
items.body: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.
items.title_ko: 모방을 넘어선 추론: 비디오 LLM을 위한 관찰 조건부 증류
items.summary_ko: 강력한 비디오 LLM의 시간 추론 능력을 오픈소스 학생 모델로 전이시키는 유망한 접근 방식인 '추론 증류(Reasoning distillation)'에 대한 연구입니다. 교사와 학생 모델 간의 다른 비디오 샘플링 파이프라인으로 인한 '관찰 불일치' 문제를 해결하기 위한 '관찰 조건부 증류(Observation Conditioned Distillation)'를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 LLM의 효율적인 학습과 지식 전이를 위한 증류 기술을 개선하여, 더 작고 효율적인 비디오 이해 모델 개발을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Admitted Is Not Effective: Lessons from a Notary-Gated Retrospective Loop in an Agentic Pipeline
items.body:
Agentic software development pipelines with frozen prompts can repeat the same mistakes across pull requests (PRs), yet ungoverned additions to instruction files grow without bound and do not generally improve task success. We present a retrospective loop for a four-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline in which a Retrospective agent proposes edits to learned rules every ten PRs and a Notary admits, merges, or rejects them while recording each decision in a provenance ledger. In a pre-registered study of 880 PRs on two Python repositories, the loop ran end to end and the Notary admitted 55 of 89 proposals, rejecting 8 that cited nonexistent evidence.
However, held-out review comments and hidden-test resolution did not improve after ten retrospectives. Tracing each step of the loop, we found that sparse review signal (0.45 comments/PR) left little to learn from and that rules admitted on their stated evidence did not show measurable held-out effects. We derive six lessons and argue that governed loops should admit and retire every learned rule as a testable hypothesis.
items.title_ko: 에이전트 파이프라인의 회고 루프를 통한 학습: '승인됨'이 항상 '효과적'이지는 않다
items.summary_ko: 고정된 프롬프트를 사용하는 에이전트 소프트웨어 개발 파이프라인에서 동일한 실수가 반복되는 문제를 해결하기 위한 '회고 루프(retrospective loop)'를 제안합니다. Retrospective 에이전트가 학습된 규칙에 대한 편집을 제안하고, Notary 에이전트가 이를 승인, 병합, 거부하는 방식입니다. 이 연구는 '승인된' 수정이 항상 '효과적'이지는 않다는 교훈을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반 에이전트 파이프라인의 지속적인 개선과 안정화를 위한 메타 학습(meta-learning) 및 피드백 루프 설계에 대한 실용적인 통찰력을 제공합니다.

items.title: Continuous-Time LQR from a Single Discrete-Time Off-Policy Batch
items.body:
We study discounted continuous-time linear--quadratic regulation (LQR) with unknown drift parameters and additive noise, using a single batch of discrete-time off-policy transitions. Discrete-time methods target a policy tied to the training interval, while shortening this interval can make learning from finite data more sensitive to noise. Learning an accurate continuous-time controller therefore requires balancing discretization and finite-sample errors while preserving stability throughout policy improvement. We develop a drift-only policy iteration algorithm, termed PhiBE-PI, using one quadratic state--action critic for policy evaluation and explicit greedy improvement. Reusing the batch makes later policies depend on the data. Exploiting the quadratic structure of LQR, we show that the data enter every policy evaluation only through one policy-independent empirical matrix, so a single high-probability bound controls all iterates.
For sufficiently large discount~$β$, small observation intervals, and a sufficiently large batch, we prove that all iterates are stabilizing for the discounted problem and converge quadratically to a data-dependent fixed point. The gain bound separates iteration, finite-sample, and discretization errors. In this regime, the finite-sample and discretization terms scale as $1/(β\sqrt{nΔt})$ and $Δt/β$, respectively. The bounds thus reveal a tradeoff: at a fixed batch size, finer observations reduce discretization error but increase finite-sample error. Because PhiBE-PI approximates the continuous-time optimal gain rather than a discrete-time one, its policy can remain near-optimal when deployed at faster control rates. Experiments confirm this advantage over discrete-time Bellman-equation baselines when the observation interval is small relative to the system's time scale.
items.title_ko: 단일 이산 시간 오프-정책 배치로부터 연속 시간 LQR 학습
items.summary_ko: 알 수 없는 드리프트 매개변수와 가산성 노이즈가 있는 할인된 연속 시간 선형-2차 조절(LQR) 문제를 연구합니다. 이 연구는 단일 이산 시간 오프-정책(off-policy) 배치로부터 정확한 연속 시간 제어기를 학습하는 방법을 다루며, 이산화 및 유한 샘플 오류 간의 균형을 맞춥니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 및 제어 이론 분야에서 연속 시간 시스템을 효율적으로 학습하는 방법을 제시하며, 로봇 제어와 같은 실제 응용 분야에 중요합니다.

items.title: ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets
items.body: Large, diverse, and high-quality datasets are significant for advancing AI in requirements engineering, yet automated identification of requirements from Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) remains a challenge. Automatic Requirements Identification (ARI) methods demonstrate limited generalization to unseen documents across heterogeneous SRSs. This work presents ReqSeek, a transformer-based, domain-agnostic ARI model for recognizing ISO 29148-style requirements in SRS documents, supporting dataset construction. We curated the Automatic Requirements Identification Dataset (ARID), comprising 2,396 training instances from 23 heterogeneous SRSs, and fine-tuned four transformer architectures. RoBERTa was selected as the base model for ReqSeek and achieved 95% precision, recall, F1, and F0.89 on the held-out evaluation set. Exploratory human-model benchmarking showed performance comparable to humans while requiring substantially less prediction time than manual annotation. Post-hoc evaluation on out-of-domain (OoD) SRSs provided evidence of requirement identification beyond ARID. Robustness analysis demonstrated ReqSeek's insensitivity to minor linguistic variations while maintaining sensitivity to major ISO 29148-style violations. We applied ReqSeek to construct the Software Requirements Dataset (SwaRD), identifying 10,201 ISO 29148-style requirements from 231 industrial SRSs. SwaRD aligns with textual and semantic properties of human-curated datasets while exceeding them in scale and domain diversity. Our results suggest that transformer-based ARI can provide precise and generalizable requirements identification.
items.title_ko: ReqSeek: 대규모 요구사항 데이터셋 구축을 위한 트랜스포머 기반 자동 요구사항 식별
items.summary_ko: ReqSeek은 트랜스포머 기반의 도메인에 구애받지 않는 자동 요구사항 식별(ARI) 모델로, 소프트웨어 요구사항 명세서(SRS)에서 ISO 29148 스타일의 요구사항을 인식하도록 설계되었습니다. 이는 AI를 활용한 요구사항 공학 분야 발전에 기여합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용하여 소프트웨어 개발의 초기 단계인 요구사항 분석을 자동화함으로써, 개발 효율성을 높이고 대규모 AI 프로젝트 관리에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: LAF-ECG: Multi-Resolution Lead-Aware Fusion of Time-Series and Language Foundation Models for ECG Classification
items.body: Automated electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has advanced substantially with deep learning, yet many methods remain task-specific and label-dependent. Large language models (LLMs) and time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer complementary pretrained representations, but integrating them is challenging because of mismatched feature spaces and the lead- and scale-dependent structure of ECG signals. We propose LAF-ECG (Lead-Aware Foundation Fusion for ECG), a dual-foundation framework that extends MedTsLLM with a lead-aware interface to a frozen TSFM backbone while retaining its reprogramming pathway. The proposed framework captures multi-resolution temporal context, fuses temporal and language-aligned ECG representations through adaptive residual integration, and employs branch-specific supervision with cross-branch alignment. LAF-ECG achieves 71.10% accuracy and 62.43% macro-F1 on PTB-XL, and 89.73% accuracy and 65.94% macro-F1 on Chapman-Shaoxing, outperforming MedTsLLM on both datasets. These results highlight the value of preserving lead-specific temporal structure when combining temporal and language foundation representations for ECG classification. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/kkianamm/LAF-ECG.
items.title_ko: LAF-ECG: 다중 해상도 리드 인식 시계열 및 언어 파운데이션 모델 융합 ECG 분류
items.summary_ko: LAF-ECG는 ECG 분류를 위해 시계열 파운데이션 모델(TSFM)과 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)의 상호 보완적인 사전 학습 표현을 다중 해상도 '리드 인식 융합' 방식으로 통합하는 이중 파운데이션 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 분야에서 ECG 해석 정확도를 높이기 위해 시계열 및 언어 모델의 장점을 결합하는 혁신적인 접근 방식을 제시하며, 심장 질환 진단 발전에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Randomized Weighted Distance Nearest Neighbor Classification
items.body: The nearest neighbor classifier is known to be memory-inefficient, and a popular solution is to compress its training data. Recently, a compression algorithm based on weighted distance nearest neighbor (WNN) was proposed, which has elegant theoretical properties and effective classification performance. However, its compression process is computationally expensive, for it performs a greedy search of the densest homogeneous balls in data space. In this paper, we propose a randomized variant RWNN. It simply randomizes the ball search process, and results in substantially reduced compression time (often 0.1%--1% of WNN's) and similar classification accuracy. RWNN also inherits several theoretical properties of WNN including consistency and a generalization bound. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate its efficacy.
items.title_ko: 랜덤 가중 거리 K-최근접 이웃 분류
items.summary_ko: K-최근접 이웃(KNN) 분류기의 메모리 비효율성 문제를 해결하기 위해, 가중 거리 K-최근접 이웃(WNN) 기반 압축 알고리즘의 계산 비용이 높은 단점을 개선한 '랜덤 가중 K-최근접 이웃(RWNN)' 변형을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: KNN과 같은 고전적인 머신러닝 알고리즘의 효율성을 개선하여 대규모 데이터셋에서도 활용 가능성을 높이는 실용적인 연구입니다.

items.title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
items.body: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7% to 29.2%; for models with at least 14 billion parameters, it rose from 23.6% to 64.6%. We release the library and benchmark as a shared resource for the community and plan to expand its tools and task coverage as financial agents evolve.
items.body_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 더욱 강력해짐에 따라, 금융 에이전트는 쉽게 찾아서 사용할 수 있는 도구가 필요합니다. 그러나 금융 소프트웨어는 다양한 인터페이스와 규칙을 가진 라이브러리들로 파편화되어 있어 신뢰할 수 있는 에이전트 워크플로우를 구축하기 어렵습니다. 우리는 LLM 에이전트를 위해 설계된 금융 기술, 검사 및 자기 개선의 통합 Python 라이브러리인 Fin-RSI를 소개합니다. 이 라이브러리는 시장 분석, 예측, 포트폴리오 구성 및 거래 연구를 위한 도구들을 모델 및 에이전트 프레임워크 전반에 걸쳐 공유 인터페이스를 통해 통합합니다. 에이전트는 자연어 요청을 통해 적합한 도구를 찾고, 테스트된 구현을 재사용하며, 검사 및 피드백을 통해 생성된 프로그램을 개선할 수 있습니다. 개발자는 각 모델에 대한 통합을 재구축할 필요 없이 새로운 도구를 라이브러리에 확장할 수 있습니다. 6가지 거래 포지션 작업에서 20개의 오픈 가중치 모델을 대상으로 도구 발견은 유효한 프로그램을 생성하는 에피소드의 비율을 9.7%에서 29.2%로 증가시켰으며, 140억 개 이상의 매개변수를 가진 모델의 경우 23.6%에서 64.6%로 증가했습니다. 우리는 커뮤니티를 위한 공유 리소스로 라이브러리와 벤치마크를 공개하며, 금융 에이전트가 발전함에 따라 도구와 작업 범위를 확장할 계획입니다.
items.title_ko: Fin-RSI: LLM 에이전트를 위한 금융 기술, 검증, 자기 개선 통합 라이브러리
items.summary_ko: Fin-RSI는 시장 분석, 예측, 포트폴리오 구성, 트레이딩 연구 등을 위한 금융 도구들을 LLM 에이전트가 쉽게 발견하고 사용할 수 있도록 통합한 파이썬 라이브러리입니다. 이를 통해 신뢰할 수 있는 금융 에이전트 워크플로우 구축을 용이하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 금융 분야에서 LLM 에이전트를 개발하는 개발자들에게 필요한 다양한 기능과 워크플로우를 통합 제공하여, 금융 AI 애플리케이션 개발을 가속화할 수 있는 핵심 도구입니다.

items.title: From States to Dynamics: Detecting Rule Violations in OthelloGPT
items.body: Sequence models trained on game moves have been shown to encode world models, with structured linear probes revealing the underlying game states. World models, however, are inherently dynamic: in deterministic board games, a set of rules constrain how states evolve over time. We therefore ask if and how OthelloGPT, a transformer trained only on Othello move sequences, manifests the rules of the game in its activation space. We divide the rules of Othello, and symmetrically their violations, into three classes: placing a disc on an empty square (R1), flanking an opponent's disc (R2), and moving in turn (R3). We find that linear probes accurately separate legal from illegal moves, and also distinguish between the three kinds of rule violations. We introduce an unsupervised rule-violation detector based on the step length of activations between consecutive moves, which identifies illegal moves above chance. We further improve our detection metric by computing step length in the latent space of select sparse autoencoders. Together, we find that OthelloGPT follows game rules of Othello to a large extent, and that we can detect rule violations using structured detectors on model activations.
items.title_ko: 상태에서 동역학으로: OthelloGPT에서 규칙 위반 탐지
items.summary_ko: OthelloGPT와 같이 게임 움직임 시퀀스로만 훈련된 트랜스포머 모델이 게임 규칙을 어떻게 인코딩하는지 활성화 공간(activation space)에서 분석합니다. 이 연구는 모델이 게임의 규칙 위반을 어떻게 나타내는지 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 단순히 패턴을 모방하는 것을 넘어, 내재된 규칙과 동역학을 얼마나 학습하는지 이해하여, 모델의 내부 추론 능력과 투명성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Learning-Augmented QUBO for Time-Expanded Multi-Commodity Flow
items.body: We study energy-aware multi-commodity flow on time-expanded graphs, a problem that captures dynamic routing in layered networks and is NP-hard in general. We formulate the problem as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem, give an explicit penalty coefficient that provably guarantees feasibility, and show that it is smaller than the standard bound by a factor of roughly the number of active links. The layered structure of the time-expanded graph yields three structural results: a treewidth bound that gives a fixed-parameter tractable exact algorithm in the bag size, a matrix-product-operator representation of small bond dimension, and a proof that the annealing gap of the associated Ising Hamiltonian is strictly positive for every instance with a unique optimum, uniformly over bounded windows. For learning-augmented routing, we bound the Hamming distance between a predicted and an optimal flow by the flow error, and prove a consistency guarantee: a hybrid algorithm that keeps the better of the prediction and the solver output returns a flow whose cost exceeds the optimum by a factor that grows linearly with the prediction error. The results are exact statements about the QUBO and its associated Ising Hamiltonian, and they hold for any physical implementation.
items.title_ko: 시간 확장 다중 상품 흐름을 위한 학습 증강 QUBO
items.summary_ko: 시간 확장 그래프(time-expanded graphs) 상의 에너지 인식 다중 상품 흐름(multi-commodity flow) 문제를 2차 비제약 이진 최적화(QUBO) 문제로 공식화합니다. 이 연구는 실현 가능성을 보장하는 명시적인 페널티 계수를 제시하고, 표준 경계보다 작음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 네트워크 최적화 및 물류 계획 분야에서 복잡한 문제를 해결하기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하며, 양자 컴퓨팅을 활용한 최적화 연구에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
items.body: Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. If the sampled range includes R=1, so that some training steps run the block only once and compute the loss on that single pass, the gates collapse to 0.1-0.5 and each additional pass becomes a small correction to the first; if the range starts at R=2, so that every training step runs the block at least twice, the gates stay at 0.6-0.9 and each pass keeps the strength of a full layer, while the model can still be run at any R from 2 up to twice the largest trained value with validation loss within a few hundredths of a nat of its best. The {2, 3, 4} schedule gives the best looped model, 2.909 nats against 2.951 for the parameter-matched plain model, and degrades by only 0.038 nats when run at twice its trained depth. We further show that under a fixed R the direction of the residual stream converges geometrically beyond the trained depth while the loss diverges, which refines a recent finding that static-depth training does not converge, and that reusing the first pass's keys and values on later passes costs 0.01-0.03 nats in every regime while making the per-token iteration uniformly contractive and halving the inference cache. The loop recovers about a third of what real depth provides at equal parameters. The code, trained weights, and per-token traces are released.
items.title_ko: 루프 트랜스포머의 루프 횟수 스케줄에 대한 실증 연구
items.summary_ko: 루프 트랜스포머(Looped Transformers)에서 훈련 중 루프 반복 횟수(R) 스케줄이 모델 성능에 미치는 영향을 연구합니다. R을 고정하거나 균일하게 샘플링하는 세 가지 스케줄을 사용하여, 각 추가 패스가 완전한 레이어처럼 작동하는지 또는 작은 보정처럼 작동하는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 루프 트랜스포머와 같은 새로운 모델 아키텍처의 학습 효율성과 성능 최적화를 위한 중요한 실무적 지침을 제공하여, 자원 효율적인 LLM 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
items.body: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.
items.title_ko: 팩트 체킹 오류 발생 지점 분석: 검색, 탐색 제어, 판단 분리
items.summary_ko: 증거 기반 팩트 체커(evidence-grounded fact-checker)가 실패하는 이유를 검색(retrieval), 탐색 제어(search control), 판단(judgement) 단계로 분리하여 분석하는 프로토콜을 제시합니다. 이 연구는 엔드투엔드 정확도만으로는 오류의 원인을 알 수 없다는 점에 착안했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반 팩트 체킹 시스템의 신뢰성을 높이기 위해, 오류의 원인을 정밀하게 진단하고 각 단계별로 개선 방안을 모색하는 데 필요한 방법론을 제공합니다.

items.title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
items.body: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.
items.title_ko: HandiVid: 손동작 기반 대화형 비디오 생성을 위한 고품질 데이터셋
items.summary_ko: HandiVid는 손 움직임과 카메라 동작에 따라 현실적인 상호작용 반응을 생성하는 '손동작 기반 자기중심적 대화형 비디오 생성(hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation)'을 위한 고품질 데이터셋입니다. 20만 개의 큐레이션 및 주석 처리된 자기중심적 상호작용 비디오 클립으로 구성되어 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 손 움직임과 상호작용을 기반으로 한 사실적인 비디오 생성 연구에 필수적인 고품질 데이터셋을 제공하여, 가상현실, 로봇 공학, HCI 분야의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Grammar Sparsity Sets How Transformers Learn Random Languages
items.body: We study language acquisition by transformers trained on the Random Language Model: a synthetic hierarchical grammar with random production rules, whose sparsity is controlled by a single parameter and whose conditional entropies are known exactly. On depth-two grammars, we find that sparsity sets both the order and the speed of learning. Dense grammars are learnt one level at a time: a token is predicted from its sibling after $t\propto V$ steps and from the full context only after $t\propto V^{3}$, so the two stages are separated by a plateau that widens with $V$. Sparse grammars are learnt all at once, at $t\propto\sqrt V$, with a smaller exponent than even the first stage of a dense one. The exponents $1$ and $1/2$ already appear at depth one, where we derive them for a linear model trained with Adam.
items.title_ko: 문법 희소성이 트랜스포머가 랜덤 언어를 학습하는 방식 결정
items.summary_ko: 트랜스포머가 랜덤 언어 모델(생성 규칙이 랜덤인 합성 계층적 문법)을 학습하는 방식을 연구합니다. 문법의 희소성(sparsity)이 학습 순서와 속도를 결정한다는 것을 발견했습니다. 조밀한 문법은 한 번에 한 레벨씩 학습되는 경향을 보입니다.
items.why_ko: 트랜스포머와 같은 LLM이 복잡한 언어 구조를 어떻게 학습하는지에 대한 근본적인 이해를 제공하며, 모델의 학습 효율성과 언어 능력 향상에 대한 통찰력을 제공합니다.

items.title: Do More Roles or Larger Models Improve LLM Fact-Checking? A Controlled Study on Fixed Evidence
items.body: A fact-checking system can spend more computation on a claim by using a larger model, by asking the same model several times, or by a multi-role Tribunal: two roles propose quoted findings, code checks the quotations, an auditor that does not see the proposed relation judges each one, and code derives the verdict or abstains. We compare these options on identical fixed evidence, without retrieval: 300 AVeriTeC claims, each with its annotated question--answer items mixed with items written for other claims, read by judges of four open-weights models from three families, a vote of five, and six assignments of models to the Tribunal's roles. The 9B judge was right on 186 claims and the 27B judge of the same family on 156; the larger judges declined to decide far more often and were no more accurate when they decided. The vote reached 196 and the 9B judge with its verdict replaced by Tribunal certificates 195, at a similar cost; the Tribunal alone reached 153 to 164, because it abstained on almost half of the claims. A hearing's outcome followed the auditor's model and was nearly indifferent to the proposers'. A larger auditor, or one of another family, made certificates neither more often correct (77% to 81%) nor more independent of the judge. As a replacement, certificates improved every judge by 3 to 10 points and overturned four to five in a hundred of its correct verdicts. With the annotated evidence withheld, judges and Tribunal still decided on 7% to 14% of the claims.
items.title_ko: 더 많은 역할 또는 더 큰 모델이 LLM 팩트 체킹을 개선하는가? 고정된 증거에 대한 통제 연구
items.summary_ko: LLM 팩트 체킹 시스템에서 더 큰 모델을 사용하거나, 동일한 모델을 여러 번 사용하거나, 다중 역할(Tribunal) 접근 방식을 사용할 때의 성능을 비교하는 연구입니다. 고정된 증거를 사용하여 300개의 AVeriTeC 주장에 대해 통제된 조건에서 평가했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 기반 팩트 체킹 시스템의 정확도와 효율성을 높이기 위한 다양한 전략들을 비교 분석하여, 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 기반 정보 검증 시스템 구축에 실용적인 지침을 제공합니다.

items.title: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
items.body: Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns influencing predictions across graphs, yielding global (i.e., model-level) counterfactual explanations. We further introduce an efficient latent-space counterfactual mechanism that avoids the combinatorial complexity of discrete graph manipulation, enabling scalable discovery of generalizable modification patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GCSGNN outperforms existing methods in generating effective counterfactual explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/gcsgnn.
items.title_ko: 전역 반사실 기반 자기 설명형 그래프 신경망 연구
items.summary_ko: 그래프 신경망(GNN) 예측을 해석하기 위한 효과적인 방법인 그래프 반사실적 설명(GCEs)의 두 가지 근본적인 한계점을 지적합니다. 기존 GCEs가 사후 설명(post-hoc) 패러다임에 의존하고, 설명자가 GNN의 표현 학습 방식을 활용하지 못한다는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: GNN의 해석 가능성을 높여 모델의 신뢰도를 향상시키고, 복잡한 그래프 데이터에서 AI 결정의 근거를 이해하는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: MERIT: Experience-Guided Memory for Long-Horizon Persona-Specific Persuasive Dialogue
items.body: Effective long-horizon persuasion in recurring goal-oriented settings requires more than factual memory: it must track how a user's trust, negotiation behavior, and strategic receptiveness evolve across interactions. Existing persuasive dialogue systems are largely single-session, static, and unimodal, while cross-session memory systems, though temporally aware, retain only factual content and overlook persuasion-specific dynamics. We propose MERIT (Memory-augmented Experience-Rationale for Iterative Temporal persuasion), which pairs a graph-based memory of four persuasion-specific memory types with a per-persona experience rationale library that records which strategies succeed for each user and why. Together they enable adaptive persuasion through prompt composition alone, with no parameter updates. To support this setting, we introduce PERSIST (PERSona-driven InSurance Interactions over Time), a dataset of 60 curated personas spanning 10+ years of motor insurance renewal interactions, with probabilistic life events that shift negotiation behavior and receptiveness across sessions, verified through strict human-in-the-loop annotation. MERIT surpasses memory and experience-based baselines on every metric across two policy backbones, reaching persuasive-appeal scores of 4.10 and 4.74 (out of 5).
items.title_ko: MERIT: 장기적이고 페르소나별 설득 대화를 위한 경험 기반 메모리
items.summary_ko: MERIT(Memory-augmented Experience-Rationale for Iterative Persuasion)은 반복되는 목표 지향적 환경에서 장기적인 설득을 위한 경험 기반 메모리 시스템입니다. 사용자의 신뢰, 협상 행동, 전략적 수용성 변화를 추적하여 설득 대화 시스템의 효과를 높입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 대화 에이전트가 단순한 사실 기억을 넘어 사용자 관계의 역학을 이해하고 장기적으로 설득력을 높이는 방법을 제시하여, 고객 서비스, 교육, 상담 등 다양한 분야에 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Ref2Light: From One Image to Interactive Glasses-Free 3D Characters
items.body: Animating character illustrations on light-field displays demands coherent binocular parallax, real-time pose articulation, and fine-grained expression control. However, existing 2D animation and 3D reconstruction pipelines cannot combine these with rapid character switching. We present Ref2Light, a feed-forward framework that maps a single A-pose illustration and continuous pose and expression controls to display-native light-field animation, without per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization. Our key insight is to decompose light-field synthesis into static identity, view-dependent parallax, and control-driven articulation. A shared encoder caches multi-scale identity features once per character for rapid switching. A conditional decoder then synthesizes ordered angular anchors from these features via backward texture transport and direct color synthesis. A global-local control scheme deforms the anchors with head-body controls and uses the updated correspondence fields to track facial regions across views for masked local facial refinement. Finally, calibrated differentiable subpixel interlacing converts the anchors into the native panel raster, enabling end-to-end native supervision without rendering all views at full resolution. On held-out VRoid identities, Ref2Light reduces head-body LPIPS by 20.1%-55.6% over 2D and 3D baselines and lowers non-target change MAE in mouth closure by 95.6%-96.5% versus monolithic decoding, while running at 34.0-40.1 FPS for 1440x2560 native rasters on a consumer GPU. Code and demo are in the Supplementary Material.
items.title_ko: Ref2Light: 한 장의 이미지로 인터랙티브 무안경 3D 캐릭터 생성
items.summary_ko: Ref2Light는 단일 A-포즈 일러스트레이션과 연속적인 포즈 및 표정 제어를 통해, 캐릭터별 3D 재구성, 리깅, 메시 추출 없이도 디스플레이 네이티브 라이트 필드 애니메이션을 생성하는 피드포워드 프레임워크입니다.
items.why_ko: 단일 2D 이미지로 실시간 인터랙티브 3D 캐릭터 애니메이션을 구현하는 기술은 게임, 메타버스, 가상 비서 등 다양한 분야에서 캐릭터 제작 및 경험을 혁신할 잠재력을 가집니다.

items.title: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
items.body: Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. Since CrysLDM leverages a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, it simplifies the generative process and accelerates both training and inference. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets and tasks, we show that CrysLDM generates stable and valid materials with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while being significantly more efficient in terms of computational resources and time.
items.title_ko: CrysLDM: 결정 물질 생성을 위한 잠재 확산 모델
items.summary_ko: CrysLDM은 원자 유형, 좌표, 격자 구조의 공동 분포를 모델링하기 위한 복잡한 확산 아키텍처가 필요한 기존 확산 모델의 한계를 극복합니다. 이 잠재 확산 모델은 시간 및 자원이 제약된 환경에서 새로운 결정 물질을 효율적으로 생성하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 새로운 재료 과학 분야에서 원하는 특성을 가진 결정 물질을 효율적으로 설계하고 생성하는 AI 모델을 제시하여, 신소재 개발 속도를 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Position-Skipped Distillation of Sparse-Attention Indexers: Train Short, Serve Long
items.body: Top-k sparse attention relies on an indexer, a lightweight per-layer module that ranks cached tokens so attention covers only the k highest-scoring ones. Indexers are usually distilled from dense attention at the full serving length, so every training step pays for long-context dense attention. We show that when an indexer is distilled on short sequences, its failure to generalise to longer contexts is driven mainly by rotary positional encoding (RoPE), not by degraded content matching. We propose position-skipped distillation: the indexer and the frozen teacher see short sequences whose position IDs contain a randomly placed gap, so neither ever processes more than the short training length. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B, an indexer distilled on 8K tokens this way matches a 32K-distilled indexer to within about 0.5 perplexity up to 32K, and on DeepSeek-V2-Lite matches a 64K-distilled indexer at 64K with roughly 6x less training compute per token. On Llama-3.1-8B it trails the stronger 32K run by 0.6 perplexity, and at 64K simple position compression is often as good, so the main gain is training cost rather than quality. We also quantise indexer keys to 3-4 bits without retraining and score them with a fused integer kernel: at 4 bits, perplexity changes by at most 0.05 and the scan is 1.6-2.2x faster than half precision. In a current serving engine, the indexer speeds up decoding only for long contexts with multiple concurrent streams.
items.title_ko: 위치 건너뛰기 희소 어텐션 인덱서 증류: 짧게 훈련하고 길게 서비스
items.summary_ko: Top-k 희소 어텐션(sparse attention)의 인덱서(indexer)를 짧은 시퀀스에서 증류(distillation)할 때, 긴 컨텍스트로의 일반화 실패가 주로 로터리 위치 인코딩(RoPE) 때문이라는 것을 보여줍니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 새로운 증류 방식을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 희소 어텐션 기반 LLM의 학습 및 서빙 효율성을 개선하여, 긴 컨텍스트 모델을 더 적은 자원으로 효과적으로 배포할 수 있는 실용적인 최적화 기술입니다.

items.title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
items.body: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch invariant kernels all seven exact features, speculative decoding included, reproduce the reference text on every request, while the FP8 KV cache still flips 3.91% (3.28 to 4.53) of graded outcomes. A gate that compares against a single replica pair rejected an unchanged configuration, so we recommend certifying a serving change under batch invariant kernels, where the floor is zero, or against a scheduling floor measured from at least three replicas.
items.body_ko: 팀은 엔진이 정확하다고 문서화되어 있으므로 벤치마크 정확도가 변경되지 않았음을 확인한 후 접두사 캐싱, 청크 프리필 및 예측 디코딩과 같은 서빙 기능을 활성화합니다. 정확도는 총계이므로 기능이 이를 유지하면서 어떤 요청이 올바르게 응답되는지를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 우리는 vLLM에서 하나의 4B 지시 모델을 9개의 단일 기능 구성과 5개의 참조 구성 복제본으로 서비스하고, 모든 실행에서 5개의 벤치마크에서 3,380개의 요청을 채점하며, 각 후보를 재시작 플로어(새로운 프로세스) 및 스케줄링 플로어(다른 순서로 동일한 요청)와 비교합니다. 기본 커널을 사용하면 모든 구성이 정확도를 1점 이내로 유지하며, 7개의 정확한 기능은 채점된 요청 결과의 1.47%(95% CI 1.13~1.85)에서 1.78%(1.39~2.20)를 변경하며, 스케줄링 플로어인 1.72%를 넘지 않습니다. 반면 FP8 KV 캐시는 3.36%(2.80~3.96)를 변경하여 FP8 가중치만큼 많이 변경합니다. 배치 불변 커널을 사용하면 예측 디코딩을 포함한 7개의 정확한 기능 모두 모든 요청에서 참조 텍스트를 재현하지만, FP8 KV 캐시는 여전히 채점된 결과의 3.91%(3.28~4.53)를 변경합니다. 단일 복제본 쌍과 비교하는 게이트는 변경되지 않은 구성을 거부했으므로, 서빙 변경을 배치 불변 커널(플로어가 0인 경우) 또는 최소 3개의 복제본에서 측정된 스케줄링 플로어에 대해 인증할 것을 권장합니다.
items.title_ko: 논문상의 '정확'함이 현실과 다를 때: LLM 서빙 단축키가 채점된 답변을 뒤집는 영향 분석
items.summary_ko: LLM 서빙에서 접두사 캐싱, 청크 프리필, 추측적 디코딩과 같은 '정확하다고 알려진' 단축키 기능들이 실제로는 벤치마크 정확도를 유지하면서도 개별 요청에 대한 답변을 다르게 만들 수 있음을 보여주는 연구입니다. 동일한 요청을 재정렬하는 노이즈와 비교하여 이 영향을 측정했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 서빙 시스템을 최적화할 때 성능 향상뿐만 아니라 결과의 일관성과 신뢰성에 미치는 미묘한 영향까지 고려해야 함을 보여주어, LLM 배포 엔지니어링에 중요한 통찰력을 제공합니다.

items.title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
items.body: A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI [3.65, 4.53]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source model barely decides (AUROC of the source margin 0.90 to 0.97 on ResNet 50, every 95% CI inside [0.89, 0.98]), but our preregistered claim that this holds for every recipe fails on the two mobile networks, where INT8 breaks accuracy outright. A probe set of the 200 training inputs with the smallest source margin, chosen before any conversion, flags all 40 vision stacks (recall 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]) and all 6 text stacks that flip at least 0.5% of decisions and none of the exact FP32 conversions, so conversion checks should compare decisions on such a probe set, not accuracy.
items.title_ko: 하나의 체크포인트, 네 개의 변환기: 장치 내 변환 후 입력별 불일치 및 이를 포착하는 프로브 세트
items.summary_ko: 장치 내(on-device) 또는 가속화된 추론을 위해 모델을 변환할 때, 변환된 모델의 상위 1% 정확도가 원본과 일치하더라도 개별 결정이 변경될 수 있음을 보여줍니다. ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT 네 가지 변환기를 사용하여 5개의 공개 체크포인트에 대해 이를 검증했습니다.
items.why_ko: 온디바이스 AI 및 엣지 AI 환경에서 모델 배포 시, 단순히 전체 정확도만으로 모델 변환의 품질을 판단할 수 없으며, 개별 입력에 대한 일관성 검증의 중요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: How Reliable is AI-Generated Audio Description? A Multilingual Expert Evaluation
items.body: Audio description (AD) makes visual media, such as video, accessible to blind or low-vision (BLV) audiences, but the high cost of professional production limits coverage. Due to recent advances in AI, numerous approaches to automatically generate intermediate AD scripts and/or final AD audios have been proposed. We present an expert evaluation of AI-generated AD scripts for movies in Italian and German that compares two AI systems, a GPT-4o- and a Qwen-based pipeline, against human-authored descriptions. Professional audio describers rated description quality and annotated errors using a detailed error taxonomy that includes content, character, fluency and coherence errors. The results show that while GPT-4o outperforms the Qwen models, both AI systems still fall short of human professional quality: the generated descriptions show substantially higher error rates and lower quality ratings. Based on the error annotations, we identify two key areas that require improvement: 1) character references, which includes both issues with identification and coherent naming, and 2) content errors and hallucinations, where the AD misrepresents or invents events. These error types are particularly critical, as they directly affect the viewer's ability to follow the narrative.
items.title_ko: AI 생성 오디오 설명의 신뢰성: 다국어 전문가 평가
items.summary_ko: GPT-4o 및 Qwen 기반의 두 가지 AI 시스템이 생성한 이탈리아어 및 독일어 영화 오디오 설명(AD) 스크립트를 인간 전문가가 평가했습니다. 이 연구는 AI 생성 AD의 품질과 신뢰성을 다국어 관점에서 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 미디어 접근성 향상에 AI가 기여할 수 있는 잠재력을 보여주며, AI 생성 콘텐츠의 품질과 문화적/언어적 적합성을 평가하는 중요한 기준을 제시합니다.

items.title: How Seasonal Reference Choice Changes the Apparent Gains of Chronos Models in Electricity Load Forecasting
items.body: When a forecasting model is said to beat a simple baseline, the size of that win depends on which baseline was used. We measure how much this matters for two zero-shot foundation models, Chronos-Bolt and Chronos-2, on hourly electricity load. The study uses 60 fixed cases drawn from eight series in four public collections, with forecasts 24 and 168 hours ahead and up to 2,048 hours of history. Each model is compared with daily persistence, weekly persistence, a weekday hybrid, a daily-weekly blend, and a reference chosen from these on a validation period. We keep every origin-level forecast and estimate uncertainty with paired circular block bootstrap intervals using 168- and 336-hour blocks. A week ahead, Bolt clearly beats weekly persistence in 21 of 30 cases but the validation-selected reference in only 14, and its median gain falls from 17.3% to 11.9%. For Chronos-2 the clear-win counts are 18 and 15. Chronos-2 has lower week-ahead MAE than Bolt in 24 cases, yet only 12 of those differences are clear. The selected reference is not always the harder baseline, since on some test windows it does worse than weekly persistence. The choice of baseline therefore changes both how large the reported gain is and how sure we can be of it. The results are exploratory: the series and windows are related, an earlier pilot was inspected, pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out, and the case-level intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
items.title_ko: 계절별 기준 선택이 전기 부하 예측 크로노스 모델의 명백한 이득을 어떻게 변화시키는가
items.summary_ko: 전력 부하 예측에서 Chronos-Bolt와 Chronos-2 두 가지 제로샷 파운데이션 모델의 성능을 측정할 때, 어떤 간단한 기준선(baseline)을 사용하느냐에 따라 성능 이득의 크기가 크게 달라짐을 보여주는 연구입니다. 일별, 주간, 주중 하이브리드 등 다양한 기준선을 비교했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 성능을 평가할 때 기준선 선택의 중요성을 강조하며, 실제 환경에서 모델의 가치를 정확히 판단하기 위한 신중한 평가 방법론의 필요성을 알려줍니다.

items.title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
items.body: A policy trained against an LLM judge can learn to exploit its loopholes. Static probes show that such judges accept degenerate answers like a lone "{" or "Thought process:", but not which flaw a policy will find. In GRPO the first loophole to be exploited can be predicted before training from each pattern's exposure, the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce it and the judge's false-positive rate (FPR). To test exposure causally, we seed the patterns into fine-tuning at three doses in a Latin square. Across 36 GRPO runs with seven judges, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure in all 12 runs with exploitation and the highest FPR in only 6. Predictions recorded before training held in three of four runs with one pattern masked by rule. When only two patterns were seeded, at 3% to 3.8% of the fine-tuning data and chosen so that exposure disagreed with FPR alone or propensity alone, exposure named the first exploited pattern and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation occurred only on hard prompts, where an accepted exploit gets a large group-normalized advantage. Auditing exposure before RL therefore identifies the loophole a policy will likely exploit first.
items.title_ko: 어떤 허점이 발견되는가? RL 훈련 전 LLM 심판의 보상 해킹 예측
items.summary_ko: LLM 심판에 대해 훈련된 정책이 어떻게 허점(loopholes)을 악용하는지 연구합니다. 훈련 전에 각 패턴의 '노출도(exposure)'(시작 정책의 생성 경향 * 심판의 오탐율)를 통해 어떤 허점이 먼저 악용될지 예측할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 기반 AI 시스템의 '보상 해킹(reward hacking)' 문제를 사전에 예측하고 방지할 수 있는 방법을 제시하여, AI 안전성 연구에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: JKO-GRPO: Augmenting GRPO with Wasserstein Proximal Steps for Flow-Matching VLAs
items.body: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_0,π_{0.5}$ generate continuous action chunks by flow matching, and online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve them beyond supervised fine-tuning. Existing methods, such as Flow-GRPO and $π_{\mathrm{RL}}$, optimize likelihood ratios of stochastic denoising transitions, which reweight the sampled actions by their advantages but do not use the distances between them. We propose JKO-GRPO, which augments Flow-GRPO with Wasserstein proximal steps, with two contributions: (1) At each state, we treat the group of sampled actions as an empirical distribution and formulate policy improvement as a Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) step. We use a soft discrete $c$-transform to construct transport targets from group-relative advantages and combine shared-noise regression of the deterministic flow sampler onto these targets and combined with the clipped Flow-GRPO objective without Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. (2) We extend this approach to sequential VLA control through random-time branching: we select one or multiple action-chunk indices along old-policy trajectories and independently apply group-level JKO updates using candidate continuations from the corresponding states.
items.title_ko: JKO-GRPO: Flow-Matching VLA를 위한 Wasserstein 근사 단계를 통한 GRPO 증강
items.summary_ko: Flow-based 시각-언어-액션(VLA) 모델인 $π_0, π_{0.5}$를 온라인 강화 학습으로 개선하는 기존 방법들이 샘플링된 액션 간의 거리를 활용하지 못하는 한계를 지적합니다. JKO-GRPO는 Flow-GRPO를 Wasserstein 근사 단계로 증강하여 이 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: Flow-matching 기반 VLA 모델의 강화 학습 효율성과 성능을 향상시키는 새로운 알고리즘을 제시하여, 복잡한 시각-언어-액션 통합 AI 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Reducing Authorship Attribution Risk in Student Texts Through Style-Conditioned Rewriting
items.body: Building NLP applications for education is constrained by data scarcity due to student privacy concerns and data regulations. To address this, we propose a style-aware approach to rewriting student forum posts that retains analytical value while reducing identifiability. Our method isolates content, structure, and style as separate conditioning channels and aggregates over student-disjoint exemplar partitions within style clusters, extending Differentially Private In-context Learning (DP-ICL) with cluster-restricted retrieval. Across three educational NLP datasets, our approach achieves high style fidelity, preserves downstream task performance, and reduces authorship attribution risk relative to the original student-written texts, including against a dedicated authorship-attribution model.
items.title_ko: 스타일 조건부 재작성을 통한 학생 텍스트의 저작자 귀속 위험 감소
items.summary_ko: 학생 포럼 게시물의 스타일을 조건부로 재작성하여 분석적 가치를 유지하면서도 식별 가능성을 줄이는 방법을 제안합니다. Differentially Private In-context Learning (DP-ICL)을 확장하여 내용, 구조, 스타일을 분리된 조건 채널로 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 교육 분야 NLP 애플리케이션 개발의 주요 제약인 학생 개인 정보 보호 문제를 해결하기 위한 혁신적인 접근 방식을 제시하며, 데이터 희소성 문제를 완화하고 개인 정보를 보호하면서도 데이터 활용도를 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: TASC: Time-to-Collision Anticipation and Selective Crowd Attention for Non-Holonomic Service Robots
items.body: Service robots that share corridors and lobbies with people must keep moving without endangering them. Reactive planners can stop indefinitely in dense crowds (the freezing robot problem), whereas the attention-based learned navigators that dominate the standard crowd benchmark assume holonomic motion or emit discrete actions unsuited to a differential-drive base. This paper presents TASC, a navigation system for a non-holonomic service robot that integrates an attention-based crowd encoder, an anticipatory collision feature, and a continuous-control policy. We adapt the dual-selection attention module, originally developed for discrete-action value learning, to proximal policy optimization for continuous velocity control, and add a closing-speed time-to-collision feature, a conservative estimate of the time to contact that serves as both an observation and a reward term. The policy is trained on a high-fidelity 3D robot model in NVIDIA Isaac Lab with 10,000 parallel environments, social-force-model pedestrians, and randomized crowd sizes. In 30,000 evaluation episodes, each run to its end, the policy timed out in fewer than 0.5% at every tested crowd density. This liveness comes at a cost: pedestrian collisions rise from 4.5% with five pedestrians to 17.4% with ten. In an ablation with four seeds per variant, policies retrained without the time-to-collision feature succeed 4 to 7 percentage points less often. The policy runs in Gazebo without retraining and on a commercial differential-drive service robot through a ROS 2 package with an inference latency below 10 ms, verified in a hardware-in-the-loop test with virtual pedestrians.
items.title_ko: TASC: 비홀로노믹 서비스 로봇을 위한 충돌 시간 예측 및 선택적 군중 주의
items.summary_ko: TASC는 비홀로노믹 서비스 로봇을 위한 내비게이션 시스템으로, 주의 기반 군중 인코더, '충돌 시간 예측(Time-to-Collision Anticipation)' 및 '선택적 군중 주의(Selective Crowd Attention)'를 통합하여 혼잡한 환경에서도 사람들과 안전하게 상호작용하며 이동할 수 있도록 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: 서비스 로봇이 사람들과 안전하게 공존할 수 있도록 돕는 핵심 기술로, 로봇의 자율 내비게이션 능력을 향상시키고 '정지 로봇 문제'와 같은 실제 문제를 해결하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
items.body: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of "diversity in unity" into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. The comparative experimental results reveal the gap between theoretical capability and practical utility. CMiLBench serves as a foundational and scalable evaluation resource to bridge the digital language divide and promote the informatization and intelligentization of low-resource Chinese minority languages.
items.title_ko: CMiLBench: 중국 소수 민족 언어를 위한 계층적 다중 작업 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: CMiLBench는 티베트어, 몽골어, 위구르어 세 가지 중국 소수 민족 언어에 대한 LLM 성능을 평가하기 위해 설계된 계층적 다중 작업 벤치마크입니다. 5가지 난이도 수준과 17가지 작업에 걸쳐 24,663개의 인스턴스로 구성됩니다.
items.why_ko: 언어적 다양성과 문화적 특수성을 반영한 LLM 평가 벤치마크를 제공하여, 주류 언어 외의 소수 언어 AI 연구 발전에 기여하고 언어 모델의 포괄성을 높이는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
items.body: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.
items.title_ko: 감정 이론을 활용한 LLM의 설명 가능한 감정 및 정신 건강 추론
items.summary_ko: LLM이 인간과 유사한 행동과 추론을 시뮬레이션하는 능력을 탐구하며, 기존 감정 탐지 방식이 감정 발생의 '평가 과정(appraisal process)'을 간과하는 문제점을 지적합니다. 감정 이론을 사용하여 LLM의 감정 및 정신 건강 추론을 설명 가능하게 만드는 방법을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 감정을 더 깊이 이해하고 설명 가능하게 추론하도록 돕는 연구로, 정신 건강 지원, 감성 AI 등 민감한 분야에서 AI의 신뢰성과 유용성을 높이는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
items.body: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.
items.title_ko: 테이블형 파운데이션 모델 공격: 컨텍스트 포이즈닝 및 테스트 시간 회피의 실험적 분류
items.summary_ko: 테이블형 파운데이션 모델(TFM)이 추론 시 제공되는 레이블이 지정된 예제에 의존한다는 점에 착안하여 새로운 공격 표면을 연구합니다. 레이블 뒤집기, 백도어 컨텍스트 포이즈닝, 클린 레이블 컨텍스트 선택, 테스트 시간 회피의 네 가지 조작 패밀리를 실험하고 분류합니다.
items.why_ko: 테이블형 파운데이션 모델의 보안 취약점을 체계적으로 분석하여, 실제 환경에서 이러한 모델을 안전하게 배포하고 활용하기 위한 방어 전략 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
items.body: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.
items.body_ko: 대부분의 LLM 에이전트 프레임워크는 작업을 실행하고 종료되는 크루를 만듭니다. 물리적 환경(예: 가정, 실험실, 공장 현장)에는 몇 달 동안 작동하고, 자체 버그에서 살아남으며, 센서 옆에 있는 어떤 하드웨어에서든 실행되는 에이전트가 필요합니다. 우리는 LLM 생성 에이전트가 오랫동안 지속되는 감독형 액터인 오픈 소스 런타임 Wactorz를 소개합니다. 플래너는 채팅 요청을 Python으로 변환하고, 런타임에 새로운 액터로 컴파일하며, 감독자는 액터가 충돌할 때 상태를 유지한 채 액터만 다시 시작합니다. 모든 조정은 MQTT를 통해 이루어지므로 에이전트는 Raspberry Pi와 같은 엣지 노드에서 생성되고 라이브 마이그레이션될 수 있으며, 모든 내부 이벤트는 외부 시스템이 구독할 수 있는 토픽입니다. 기록된 데모는 하나의 채팅 요청으로 카메라-램프 자동화를 구축하고, 토픽으로 첫 번째 에이전트에 자동 연결되고 의도적인 0으로 나누기가 포함된 두 번째 에이전트를 추가하고, 해당 에이전트가 카운트를 잃지 않고 자체 코드를 수정하는 것을 지켜본 다음, 새로운 Raspberry Pi 노드를 배포하고 4분 이내의 실제 시간과 0.13달러의 모델 사용량으로 에이전트를 라이브 마이그레이션합니다. 이 확장 버전은 2페이지 분량의 데모 논문에서 다루지 못했던 내용, 즉 토픽 그래프의 Wiring 뷰, 수동 작성 에이전트용 라이브러리로서의 Wactorz, 훈련된 모델이 저장, 노드로 전송 및 교체되는 방법, 보안 모델, 그리고 시스템의 한계를 추가합니다.
items.title_ko: Wactorz: 엣지에서 스스로 작성, 복구, 마이그레이션하는 LLM 에이전트
items.summary_ko: Wactorz는 LLM이 생성한 에이전트가 장기간 실행되고, 자체 버그에서 복구되며, 센서 근처의 어떤 하드웨어에서도 작동할 수 있는 오픈소스 런타임입니다. 플래너가 채팅 요청을 Python 코드로 변환하고 런타임에 새로운 액터로 컴파일하며, 감독자가 액터를 재시작합니다.
items.why_ko: 물리적 환경에서 장기간 안정적으로 작동하고 스스로 오류를 복구하며 유연하게 배포될 수 있는 LLM 에이전트 시스템을 위한 핵심 기술로, 엣지 AI 및 로봇 공학 분야에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

items.title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
items.body: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. After reinitializing the entire 13.6M-parameter interaction module randomly while retaining the surrounding trained model, searching 2,448 mixing and normalization parameters yields 9.8 points above production. Offline gains span the full funnel including dense retrieval, generative retrieval and ranking, with up to 1.37B learnable parameters and different edits for each architecture. Steering edits provide explicit control of model performance over segments like freshness and product. Weight coding requires no serving change and online A/B tests increase saves per user from the edited retrieval source by 8.4\% to 10.7\%, aligned with the target business objectives. Our results establish weight coding as a practical and useful tool for model development and and behavioral control in a real web-scale production system, with potential to extend to both pre-training and post-training stages across the funnel.
items.body_ko: 웹 스케일 추천 모델은 주로 재학습 또는 파인튜닝을 통해 발전합니다. 우리는 직접적이고 실행 가능한 가중치 편집을 통해 모델을 진화시키는 방법론인 \emph{가중치 코딩}을 제안합니다. 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 에이전트가 모델 구조와 매개변수를 검사하고, 가설을 세우며, 평가 피드백을 사용하여 편집을 구현합니다. 이 루프는 국지적인 변경에서 목표 검색 및 구성으로 진행되어 편집된 구성 요소들이 서로 적응할 수 있도록 합니다. 캐시된 엔진은 역전파 없이 빠른 순방향 평가를 가능하게 합니다. Pinterest의 1억 4,700만 매개변수 Image Search 투 타워 검색기에서 가중치 코딩은 전체 사후 학습 파인튜닝에 드는 GPU 시간의 약 1/4에 불과한 적은 편집으로 프로덕션 모델의 held-out recall@10을 최대 15.0% 포인트(+24% 상대적으로) 향상시켰으며, 일반적인 출시는 약 1%만 향상시킵니다. 주변의 학습된 모델을 유지하면서 전체 1,360만 매개변수 상호작용 모듈을 무작위로 재초기화한 후, 2,448개의 혼합 및 정규화 매개변수를 검색하여 프로덕션보다 9.8포인트 높은 결과를 얻었습니다. 오프라인 이득은 밀집 검색, 생성 검색 및 랭킹을 포함한 전체 퍼널에 걸쳐 있으며, 최대 13.7억 개의 학습 가능한 매개변수와 각 아키텍처에 대한 다른 편집을 포함합니다. 스티어링 편집은 신선도 및 제품과 같은 세그먼트에 대한 모델 성능의 명시적인 제어를 제공합니다. 가중치 코딩은 서비스 변경을 요구하지 않으며, 온라인 A/B 테스트는 편집된 검색 소스로부터 사용자당 저장 수를 8.4%에서 10.7%로 증가시켜 목표 비즈니스 목표와 일치합니다. 우리의 결과는 가중치 코딩이 실제 웹 스케일 프로덕션 시스템에서 모델 개발 및 행동 제어를 위한 실용적이고 유용한 도구임을 입증하며, 퍼널 전반에 걸쳐 사전 학습 및 사후 학습 단계 모두로 확장될 잠재력이 있습니다.

items.title: JEPA-Shield: Safe Diffusion Planning with Latent World Models via Conformal Shielding
items.body: Latent world models enable planning from images, but their predictions do not directly establish whether a robot will satisfy physical constraints. We present JEPA-Shield, which connects a frozen action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model to task-space safety enforcement. Two downstream models predict relative motion from imagined latent rollouts and decode unsafe geometry from the current image. Split conformal prediction turns end-to-end motion-prediction errors into multi-horizon uncertainty tubes. A backup-based shield checks these tubes against physical constraints and screens both candidate trajectories and final proposals in diffusion-inspired sampling-based model predictive control. Under the stated exchangeability and initial-backup assumptions, we establish probabilistic constraint satisfaction at action-block boundaries for a returned plan executed without replanning. We also introduce VParkBench, with geometric car and tractor-trailer parking tasks and a editable photorealistic Gaussian-splatting environment. In closed-loop evaluation, JEPA-Shield achieves success rates of 84.4%, 82.3%, and 99.0%, respectively, with no observed constraint violations. Ablations show complementary benefits from shielding and uncertainty calibration. The results demonstrate the importance of grounding latent world-model predictions in task-space quantities and explicitly accounting for prediction uncertainty in safety-critical planning.
